definition.simple: A modern tractor-driven machine that plants seeds in perfect lines and covers them with soil.
definition.academic: An agricultural implement used for sowing seeds at uniform distances and proper depth, ensuring they are covered by soil to protect them from birds.

examples: A farmer using a tractor with a seed drill to quickly sow a large field of soybeans.

common_misconceptions: Seed drills only drop seeds. (Truth: They also cover the seeds with soil to protect them.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student why covering seeds with soil immediately after planting is important.
